WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    p.fundflux,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.arcref) as arcref_count
  FROM scanspatial s
  JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry
  WHERE s.arcref IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(arcref_count) as total_count
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    s1.fundflux,
    s1.arcref_count,
    CAST(s1.arcref_count AS REAL) / s2.total_count as ratio
  FROM step1 s1, step2 s2
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(arcref_count AS REAL)) as avg_count
  FROM step1
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT 
    s3.fundflux,
    s3.arcref_count,
    s3.ratio,
    s3.arcref_count - s4.avg_count as diff
  FROM step3 s3, step4 s4
  WHERE s3.arcref_count > s4.avg_count
)
SELECT * FROM step5
